name: Fitboard
tagline: Answer five quick questions and get a furnishing plan with real prices, inside budget
description: It walks you through five prompts about your place, your budget, the rooms, the style you like and the country, then assembles a furnishing plan drawn from real product listings, with actual store prices and photos rather than guesses. The total is capped at the budget you named, and it arrives as a PDF.
author: e2bitz_83
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
